info.title: HomeNode chat API
info.description: Implemented chat slice. Production requires trusted HTTPS and Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict __Host-homenode sessions with ai capability. All responses are no-store. Development uses homenode-dev on localhost. This contract does not claim model licensing/performance, guest erasure or installed-network qualification; other API slices remain separate.

get.description: List up to 100 household conversations, newest first. Deletion flags describe durable cleanup state. Requires ai capability.

200.description: List up to 100 household conversations, newest first. Deletion flags describe durable cleanup state. Requires ai capability.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

post.description: Create a metadata-only conversation (maximum 100). The title must be nonblank, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, and contain no NUL, CR, LF, slash or backslash. Matching keyed retries return the original existing conversation before maintenance/quota admission; changed intent conflicts. A deleted conversation is never recreated by replay.

201.description: Create a metadata-only conversation (maximum 100). The title must be nonblank, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, and contain no NUL, CR, LF, slash or backslash. Matching keyed retries return the original existing conversation before maintenance/quota admission; changed intent conflicts. A deleted conversation is never recreated by replay.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

title.description: Limit is 80 UTF-8 bytes, not only Unicode characters.

get.description: Read up to 100 stored generations from the AI guest, oldest first. A conversation with no saved generations can return an empty list without contacting the guest; failure to read saved guest content is an error. Requires ai capability. Missing conversations return 404 instead of an empty history/export; malformed resource IDs return 400, after authentication.

200.description: Read bounded stored generations from the AI guest. Guest unavailability is an error, not an empty history. Requires ai capability.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

get.description: Download JSON history as attachment homenode-conversation.json. Requires ai capability. Missing conversations return 404 instead of an empty history/export; malformed resource IDs return 400, after authentication.

200.description: Download JSON history as attachment homenode-conversation.json. Requires ai capability.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

post.description: Journal one generation with a stable device-bound key. Prompt must contain nonwhitespace text, be valid UTF-8 and at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Retries return the original generation; concurrent/changed intent and deletion conflicts refuse. Requires ai capability and a running AI app. Acceptance is not completed inference. Replay still requires an available AI app and readable existing history; only conversation creation bypasses maintenance/quota admission for observation of an existing result.

202.description: Journal one generation with a stable device-bound key. Prompt must contain nonwhitespace text, be valid UTF-8 and at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Retries return the original generation; concurrent/changed intent and deletion conflicts refuse. Requires ai capability and a running AI app. Acceptance is not completed inference.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

prompt.description: At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; whitespace-only input is refused.

get.description: Observe generation state and accumulated output; client polling must remain serialized. Requires ai capability.

200.description: Observe generation state and accumulated output; client polling must remain serialized. Requires ai capability.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

post.description: Request cancellation. Acknowledgment does not mean cancellation/guest cleanup has completed. Requires ai capability. The body is not read; first-party clients send an empty JSON object.

202.description: Request cancellation. Acknowledgment does not mean cancellation/guest cleanup has completed. Requires ai capability.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

post.description: Begin fresh passkey approval for irreversible stored-message deletion. Requires ai capability, an existing conversation and no active generations. Finish the ceremony through /auth/approval/finish in device-approvals.openapi.json. Preserve exact request bytes and the same key for dispatch.

200.description: Begin fresh passkey approval for irreversible stored-message deletion. Requires ai capability, an existing conversation and no active generations. Finish the ceremony through /auth/approval/finish in device-approvals.openapi.json. Preserve exact request bytes and the same key for dispatch.

default.description: Structured error; includes unauthenticated (401), capability/approval/origin refusal (403), missing resource (404), conflicting state/maintenance (409), capacity (507), and unavailable workload (503).

post.description: Consume the exact approval and journal durable cleanup together. Observe deletionPending/deletionRequiresAction on the conversation list. Pending acknowledgment is not data erasure; new messages remain blocked during cleanup. Requires ai capability.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly match the configured HTTPS origin for every POST.

RequiredKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredKey.description: Device-bound stable key. Reuse exactly the same intent after an unknown outcome.

OptionalKey.name: Idempotency-Key
OptionalKey.description: Recommended. With a key, creation is durable and replayable. Missing keys preserve the legacy non-idempotent behavior.

Approval.name: X-Action-Approval
Approval.description: Fresh passkey approval bound to this session, device, epoch, policy, exact request bytes, conversation and idempotency key.
